684	-- SECTION 6a — AUDIT TRIGGER: commission_splits
685	--
686	-- Pattern from 20260429092408_inventory_audit_trigger.sql (fn_inventory_audit).
687	-- Writes INSERT events to audit_log. UPDATE/DELETE are never expected
688	-- (commission_splits is append-only) but audited if they somehow occur.
689	-- actor_id = auth.uid() — NULL for service-role / system writes.
690	-- =============================================================================
691	
692	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_commission_splits_audit()
693	RETURNS TRIGGER
694	LANGUAGE plpgsql
695	SECURITY DEFINER
696	SET search_path = public
697	AS $$
698	DECLARE
699	  v_row       jsonb;
700	  v_old_row   jsonb;
701	  v_studio_id uuid;
702	  v_target_id text;
703	BEGIN
704	  -- Throttle: skip cascaded trigger depth to prevent audit floods
705	  IF pg_trigger_depth() > 1 THEN
706	    RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
707	  END IF;
708	
709	  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
710	    v_row     := row_to_json(OLD)::jsonb;
711	    v_old_row := v_row;
712	  ELSIF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
713	    v_row     := row_to_json(NEW)::jsonb;
714	    v_old_row := NULL;
715	  ELSE
716	    v_row     := row_to_json(NEW)::jsonb;
717	    v_old_row := row_to_json(OLD)::jsonb;
718	  END IF;
719	
720	  v_studio_id := (v_row->>'studio_id')::uuid;
721	  v_target_id := v_row->>'id';
722	
723	  INSERT INTO audit_log (
724	    action,
725	    actor_id,
726	    studio_id,
727	    target_type,
728	    target_id,
729	    details,
730	    created_at
731	  )
732	  VALUES (
733	    'commission_splits.' || lower(TG_OP),
734	    auth.uid(),
735	    v_studio_id,
736	    'commission_splits',
737	    v_target_id,
738	    CASE
739	      WHEN TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN jsonb_build_object('new', v_row)
740	      WHEN TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN jsonb_build_object('old', v_old_row, 'new', v_row)
741	      WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN jsonb_build_object('old', v_row)
742	    END,
743	    now()
744	  );
745	
746	  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
747	END;
748	$$;

751	  'L2 S13 — Audit trigger for commission_splits. Writes to audit_log. '
752	  'actor_id is NULL for service-role / system writes. '
753	  'commission_splits is append-only; UPDATE/DELETE are audited as anomalies.';

/**
 * RPC contract tests: stripe_charge_record
 *
 * Coverage (4 tests):
 *  1. Happy path — inserts and returns { id, created: true }
 *  2. Replay — same idempotency_key returns { created: false, same id }
 *  3. Missing studio FK raises FK violation
 *  4. CentsAmount values stored exactly (amount_cents, tax, fee, tip, etc.)
 */

import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest'
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto'
import {
  hasDb,
  getTestServiceClient,
  createTestStudio,
  cleanupStudio,
} from './helpers'
import {
  RPC,
  cents,
  type StripeChargeRecordArgs,
  type StripeChargeRecordResult,
} from '@/lib/payments/contracts'

describe.skipIf(!hasDb)('RPC: stripe_charge_record', () => {
  let sb: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getTestServiceClient>>
  let studioId: string

  beforeAll(async () => {
    sb = await getTestServiceClient()
    const studio = await createTestStudio()
    studioId = studio.id
  })

  afterAll(async () => {
    await cleanupStudio(studioId)
  })

  function buildArgs(overrides: Partial<StripeChargeRecordArgs> = {}): StripeChargeRecordArgs {
    return {
      studioId,
      paymentIntentId: `pi_${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 24)}`,
      status: 'processing',
      currency: 'usd',
      amountCents: cents(15000),
      taxAmountCents: cents(1238),
      applicationFeeCents: cents(4500),
      netArtistCents: cents(9262),
      tipAmountCents: cents(500),
      bookingId: null,
      projectId: null,
      sessionId: null,
      clientId: null,
      depositDrawdownCents: cents(0),
      idempotencyKey: `idem_${randomUUID()}` as ReturnType<typeof cents> extends never
        ? never
        : string & { readonly __brand: 'InkosIdempotencyKey' },
      presentmentCurrency: null,
      presentmentAmountCents: null,
      ...overrides,
    }
  }

  it('happy path — inserts row and returns { id, created: true }', async () => {
    const args = buildArgs()

    const { data, error } = await sb.rpc(RPC.STRIPE_CHARGE_RECORD, {
      p_studio_id: args.studioId,
      p_payment_intent_id: args.paymentIntentId,
      p_status: args.status,
      p_currency: args.currency,
      p_amount_cents: args.amountCents,
      p_tax_amount_cents: args.taxAmountCents,
      p_application_fee_cents: args.applicationFeeCents,
      p_net_artist_cents: args.netArtistCents,
      p_tip_amount_cents: args.tipAmountCents,
      p_booking_id: args.bookingId,
      p_project_id: args.projectId,
      p_session_id: args.sessionId,
      p_client_id: args.clientId,
      p_deposit_drawdown_cents: args.depositDrawdownCents,
      p_idempotency_key: args.idempotencyKey,
      p_presentment_currency: args.presentmentCurrency,
      p_presentment_amount_cents: args.presentmentAmountCents,
    })

    expect(error).toBeNull()
    const result = data as StripeChargeRecordResult
    expect(result.created).toBe(true)
    expect(result.id).toBeTruthy()
    expect(result.id).toMatch(
      /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/,
    )
  })

  it('replay — same idempotency_key returns created=false and same id', async () => {
    const args = buildArgs()
    const callArgs = {
      p_studio_id: args.studioId,
      p_payment_intent_id: args.paymentIntentId,
      p_status: args.status,
      p_currency: args.currency,
      p_amount_cents: args.amountCents,
      p_tax_amount_cents: args.taxAmountCents,
      p_application_fee_cents: args.applicationFeeCents,
      p_net_artist_cents: args.netArtistCents,
      p_tip_amount_cents: args.tipAmountCents,
      p_booking_id: args.bookingId,
      p_project_id: args.projectId,
      p_session_id: args.sessionId,
      p_client_id: args.clientId,
      p_deposit_drawdown_cents: args.depositDrawdownCents,
      p_idempotency_key: args.idempotencyKey,
      p_presentment_currency: args.presentmentCurrency,
      p_presentment_amount_cents: args.presentmentAmountCents,
    }

    const { data: first, error: e1 } = await sb.rpc(RPC.STRIPE_CHARGE_RECORD, callArgs)
    expect(e1).toBeNull()
    const firstResult = first as StripeChargeRecordResult
    expect(firstResult.created).toBe(true)

    const { data: second, error: e2 } = await sb.rpc(RPC.STRIPE_CHARGE_RECORD, callArgs)
    expect(e2).toBeNull()
    const secondResult = second as StripeChargeRecordResult
    expect(secondResult.created).toBe(false)
    expect(secondResult.id).toBe(firstResult.id)
  })

  it('missing studio FK raises FK violation error', async () => {
    const args = buildArgs({ studioId: randomUUID() })

    const { error } = await sb.rpc(RPC.STRIPE_CHARGE_RECORD, {
      p_studio_id: args.studioId,
      p_payment_intent_id: args.paymentIntentId,
      p_status: args.status,
      p_currency: args.currency,
      p_amount_cents: args.amountCents,
      p_tax_amount_cents: args.taxAmountCents,
      p_application_fee_cents: args.applicationFeeCents,
      p_net_artist_cents: args.netArtistCents,
      p_tip_amount_cents: args.tipAmountCents,
      p_booking_id: null,
      p_project_id: null,
      p_session_id: null,
      p_client_id: null,
      p_deposit_drawdown_cents: args.depositDrawdownCents,
      p_idempotency_key: args.idempotencyKey,
      p_presentment_currency: null,
      p_presentment_amount_cents: null,
    })

    expect(error).not.toBeNull()
    expect(error?.code ?? error?.message).toMatch(/23503|foreign.key|violates/i)
  })

  it('CentsAmount values stored exactly in DB', async () => {
    const args = buildArgs({
      amountCents: cents(99999),
      taxAmountCents: cents(8237),
      applicationFeeCents: cents(29999),
      netArtistCents: cents(61763),
      tipAmountCents: cents(1500),
      depositDrawdownCents: cents(5000),
    })

    const { data, error } = await sb.rpc(RPC.STRIPE_CHARGE_RECORD, {
      p_studio_id: args.studioId,
      p_payment_intent_id: args.paymentIntentId,
      p_status: args.status,
      p_currency: args.currency,
      p_amount_cents: args.amountCents,
      p_tax_amount_cents: args.taxAmountCents,
      p_application_fee_cents: args.applicationFeeCents,
      p_net_artist_cents: args.netArtistCents,
      p_tip_amount_cents: args.tipAmountCents,
      p_booking_id: null,
      p_project_id: null,
      p_session_id: null,
      p_client_id: null,
      p_deposit_drawdown_cents: args.depositDrawdownCents,
      p_idempotency_key: args.idempotencyKey,
      p_presentment_currency: null,
      p_presentment_amount_cents: null,
    })

    expect(error).toBeNull()
    const result = data as StripeChargeRecordResult

    const { data: row } = await sb
      .from('stripe_charges')
      .select(
        'amount_cents, tax_amount_cents, application_fee_cents, net_artist_cents, tip_amount_cents, deposit_drawdown_cents',
      )
      .eq('id', result.id)
      .maybeSingle()

    expect(row?.amount_cents).toBe(99999)
    expect(row?.tax_amount_cents).toBe(8237)
    expect(row?.application_fee_cents).toBe(29999)
    expect(row?.net_artist_cents).toBe(61763)
    expect(row?.tip_amount_cents).toBe(1500)
    expect(row?.deposit_drawdown_cents).toBe(5000)
  })
})
